vision), our benefits portal has step?by?step videos available under ?Claim Management.? If you
encounter any issues, feel free to reach out to me directly at leahyoung@example.net or call the
helpdesk at 555?123?4567. Thank you for your attention to this matter, and please let me know if
anything needs clarification.
Best regards,
Pamela Henry
Benefits Coordinator
